title: UI风格#40 - Sakura Dream (樱花梦境)
description: 创建第40种UI风格：樱花梦境风格 - 日式樱花、柔和粉色、春季浪漫。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAN.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Dream style When color palette Then features sakura pinks, cherry blossoms, soft whites, spring greens
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #FFB7C5 (樱粉), #FFDFD3 (白樱), #98D8C8 (春绿), #F7F3F0 (雪白), #E8A0BF (深樱) palette

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Dream style When typography Then uses elegant Japanese: Shippori Mincho, Noto Serif JP, or Yoshino YaYa
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Shippori Mincho (标题), Noto Serif JP (正文)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Dream style When layout Then falling petals, soft gradients, zen garden composition
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: falling petal animation (20 petals), gradient background snow-white→white-sakura→rose, SVG branch silhouette

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Dream style When UI elements Then petal animations, soft glows, paper textures, branch silhouettes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: CSS petal fall animation, glass-morphism cards with blur(20px), rounded 30px borders, petal-shaped buttons

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Dream UI When functional Then includes zen chat, blossom agents, garden stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: chat interface with messages, 4 agent cards (Dev/RAG/PM/Test) with growing/resting states, stats grid

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Sakura Dream UI When copy Then uses poetic spring: 'Sakura', 'Hanami', 'Spring', 'Petals'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'SAKURA. HANAMI. SPRING.', button 'SCATTER', agent names with 🌸 emoji, status 'Growing'/'Resting'
